notation.F: cumulative signed funding paid since entry; credits negative

inherited_specification.rule: After each observed funding settlement, compute required stop from updated signedF; long=max(previousstop,requiredstop);short=min(previousstop,requiredstop). Credits never loosen protection. Activate from settlement+1minute; if quote already beyond level, exit on the next observed minute-open under original stop execution. Gaps and further costs can exceed the planned loss; this is not a guarantee of capped realized risk. No new price target or max hold.

inherited_rules.hypothesis: Persistent directional evidence after volatility normalization can identify larger moves and avoid costly one-day shock entries. Bounded evidence S01 is the single primary; unbounded S00 is the mechanistic control. Not a probability forecast or an assumption that financial returns are Gaussian.

Earlier hourly compression/retest, pullback, relative-value/continuation, funding exhaustion, range reversion, shock/network and Cipher tests recorded. This is sequential change evidence, not a new token whitelist or another channel length. Momentum mechanism overlaps; no statistical independence claim.

data.universe: 96 retained perpetual tokens, actual available history; historical dead tokens retained within this supplied universe, not a point-in-time whole-exchange universe
data.time_split: 2022 development reporting; 2023-25 later evaluation already repeatedly researched, not clean holdout

signal.clock: Daily midnight UTC after all24hourly closes complete; bar close timestamps belong to preceding day. No external volume/depth assumed.
signal.scale: Population std of60 complete DAILY log returns immediately preceding the current daily return. Exclude current observation. No filling missing daily returns. Require all60.
signal.z: current daily log return / prior sigma; zero drift null reference.
signal.S01: clip z to [-3,+3]; Cplus=max(0,Cplus+z-0.5), Cminus=max(0,Cminus-z-0.5). Long when Cplus>=5; short when Cminus>=5. Reset both after any signal, including signals while occupied. Missing z resets evidence.
signal.S00: Identical but z is unbounded. Only one primary and one control; no parameter grid.
signal.parameter_rationale: NIST conventional k=0.5,h=5 are an external initial design, not finance significance calibration. The analyst-selected3sigma cap limits one daily observation to2.5 evidence units; at least two daily observations needed. No parameters fit to historical PnL.

trade.entry: New threshold event, next minute open (main +1min; delay +6min), one open position per token/arm/cost/timing. Signals at or before prior exit are unavailable; no immediate flip. No refilling missed signals.
trade.stop: Fixed raw_entry*(1-side*2*entry_sigma). Executable stop distance must be0.5%-15%; reject nonpositive stop. No target, trailing adjustment or max holding time.
trade.exit: Opposite subsequent threshold at its decision+delay, or first observed minute-open stop breach filled next minute. Stop wins same-clock conflict. Invalid scale exits on daily clock. End-of-history marks explicit.
trade.funding: Actual recorded settlements strictly after entry through exit, signed quantity*settlement minute-open price proxy; no mark-price history. Funding age <=480min and settlement quote finite required. First missing quote/stale funding terminates at last valid mark, costs charged, data_censor flag; later entries for that token/book stopped. Censor is not an executable fill.
trade.notional: 1000USDT executed entry per independent opportunity, quantity fixed. Overlapping token opportunities are NOT a shared funded account; totals/R/drawdowns do not imply account ROI.

costs.roles: Baseline/moderate and exact0.31%perleg desk lead; severe secondary, not sole veto. Each cost independently admits by stop distance; fixed baseline-sample repricing also reported.

inherited_rules.risk_metric: R=net trade PnL / original executable-entry-to-raw-stop price risk, includes costs/funding in numerator. Planned cost-aware loss shown separately. Sum R unweighted; opportunity drawdown USDT/R measured at observed minute opens, not funded-equity drawdown%.

implementation_clarifications.arms: S01F is the single primary bounded-evidence candidate with funding protection. S00F is the unbounded control with the same protection. S01/S00 are exact parent controls. A positive control cannot silently replace the primary.
implementation_clarifications.F: Net signed cumulative funding strictly after entry through the latest settlement available. Payments positive, credits negative. Use actual recorded intervals; no invented regular8h schedule.
implementation_clarifications.activation: At observed minute t, only settlements through t-1 may affect the active stop. Quantity fixed. At any stop crossing, fill next minute with stop-specific adverse costs. All funding through the actual exit is included once.
implementation_clarifications.rounding: For known cumulative funding exactlyzero, required stop is exactly initial stop; avoids an artificial floating-point ratchet. No threshold rounding, performance tolerance or parameter change.
implementation_clarifications.stop_types: Classify as stop for execution costs; dedicated exit_kind=funding_stop if active level is tighter than initial. Opposite signal and original stop priority unchanged.
implementation_clarifications.uncertainty: 4000 synchronized circular calendar week blocks,4week primary and13week sensitivity. Seed20261026+block. Absolute S01F full/later cohort meanR and net plus paired S01F-minus-S01 calendar PnL across3centralcosts; six absolute and six incremental contrasts jointly family95% using0.025/12 quantiles. Controls diagnostic. Reused history and prior adaptive tests not corrected by this within-family adjustment.
implementation_clarifications.decomposition: Primary paired-entry diagnostic replays every original entry with funding protection at identical entry/quantity/cost. Separately bridge common actual entries, removed parent entries, added new entries and raw-signal occupancy decisions. Sums reconcile total net and R; not funded account returns.
implementation_clarifications.gate: Apply parent economic/support/latency/funding-stress gates unchanged to primary S01F. If any fail, reject it. S00F gate results reported separately. No funded portfolio replay unless a new candidate passes.
implementation_clarifications.loss_budget: L0 is original planned cost-aware loss, not price-R denominator. Report actual net loss/L0, dollars over budget, worst overshoot, stop/other exits, and gaps. Protection is not a guarantee against gaps, funding between trigger/fill, or model error.
implementation_clarifications.report: Years2022/2023/2024/2025,full/later; complete token and sector rows, side, regime, cost, drawdownR/USDT, funding/fees/slippage, duration and censoring. Existing I/IC funded benchmarks shown separately where verified, no apples-to-oranges superiority.

source_verification.fact_used: USDT linear funding uses quantity times mark price times rate; pay/receive depends on side and rate. Settlement timing can be uncertain within a few seconds.
source_verification.data_limitation: Retained cache uses settlement minute-open as a mark-price proxy. No exact historical mark prices, orderbook, spread/depth or liquidation account model. One-minute activation lag is explicit and conservative relative to the coarse recorded timing.
